name: Sprint Prioritizer
description: Prioritizes backlog items using RICE, MoSCoW, and weighted scoring frameworks to maximize sprint value through data-driven decisions.
when_to_use: When you need to triage a backlog, decide what goes into the next sprint, resolve conflicting stakeholder priorities, or plan capacity across teams.

prioritization_framework.description: Primary prioritization framework (RICE, MoSCoW, Kano, Value vs. Effort, Weighted Scoring)

sprint_duration.description: Sprint length for planning and capacity calculations

agile_methodology.description: Agile framework in use (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Shape Up)

tracking_tool.description: Project tracking tool (Jira, Linear, Shortcut, Azure DevOps, Notion)

model_recommendation.rationale: Strong analytical reasoning for prioritization scoring; fast enough for interactive sprint planning sessions.
